name: Intrinsic Neural Fields Training Pipeline
definition: A training procedure for learning functions on discrete 2-manifolds by embedding surface points into the first d eigenfunctions of the Laplace-Beltrami operator and predicting properties (e.g., RGB color) via a neural network Fθ.
summary: The Intrinsic Neural Fields Training Pipeline learns surface properties by embedding points into Laplace-Beltrami eigenfunctions, adapting to intrinsic geometry unlike fixed Fourier encodings.
